An '''Unidentified clone navigation officer''' served with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Keelyvine Reus]] during the [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] campaign. He was charged with contacting [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] in preparation for a briefing, but was forced to retrieve the pair personally when he discovered that Ganch's communicator was off.<ref name="Act on Instinct" />
